t: $(thing)Smart Filters/$ can be inserted into a $(l:intro/modules)module's/$ filter slots in place of regular items.  Instead of just trying to match against the item directly, filters have special matching functionality.$(p)For example, the $(l:filters/bulk_item)Bulk Item Filter/$ can efficiently match against up to 54 different items, and its items can be configured from an existing inventory.
$(thing)智能过滤器/$可以插入到$(l:intro/modules)模块/$的过滤器槽位中，用来替代普通物品。它们不会仅仅直接与物品本身进行匹配，而是具备特殊的匹配功能。$(p)例如，$(l:filters/bulk_item)批量物品过滤器/$就可以高效匹配多达 54 种不同物品，并且其中的物品可以直接从已有容器中进行配置。
$(italic)Bulk Item Filter installed in a Puller Mk2 Module/$
$(italic)安装在抽取模块 Mk12型中的批量物品过滤器/$
